distribution.narrative: Beaver et al. (2019) reports Dryocoetiops apatoides from Yunnan and Taiwan; the Yunnan record includes Xishuangbanna locality detail.

host_note: No host evidence is supplied in the currently integrated Beaver et al. (2019) record.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetiops apatoides (Eichhoff, 1876).

nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Dryocoetiops apatoides (Eichhoff, 1876), VSN_2449, Scolytinae: Dryocoetini. Beaver et al. (2019) uses the same species name with authorship presented as Eichhoff.
